[DEFAULT]
bantime = 2h
usedns = no
[apache-overflows]
enabled = true
logpath = /dev/null tail
action = %(action_)s
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=ddos]
port = http,https
[selinux-ssh]
enabled = true
backend = pyinotify
logpath = /dev/null
bantime = -1
ignoreip = ::1 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.1.1
[mysqld-auth]
enabled = true
backend = systemd
maxretry = x
findtime = 3600
action = nftables-multiport[blocktype=DROP, port="80,443"]
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=errors]
